name: What is the typical process for laminate flooring installation?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical process for laminate flooring installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Laminate flooring installation generally begins with preparing the subfloor, ensuring it is clean, dry, and level. Next, an underlayment is often installed to provide moisture protection, sound absorption, and cushioning. The laminate planks are then installed, usually starting from one wall, using a click-lock system. Careful planning is needed for cuts around obstacles like doorways and cabinets. Finally, transition pieces and baseboards are reinstalled to give a finished look. Professional installation ensures proper expansion gaps and a durable finish.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installation involves subfloor preparation, underlayment, laying click-lock planks, and finishing with trim. Professional help ensures proper techniques for a durable floor.
